name: Arena shooter
description: Survive growing waves of enemies in a neon arena: move with one hand, aim and shoot with the other.
controls: WASD or arrow keys to move, mouse to aim, hold left click to shoot, R to restart (gamepad: left stick to move, right stick to aim, right trigger to shoot)
features: Waves of enemies that grow and speed up
Two enemy types: fast Chasers and tough Brutes
Score, a health bar and a wave banner
Muzzle flash, hit flash, screen shake and explosions
A game-over screen with play again
